Good food
Jun 2017 • Family
This place has one of the best bbq pork in Ho Chi Minh!! The crispy rice is very unique and delicious, in fact, so unique that I have never eaten or heard of it in other plaves,including singapore, malaysia, and the philiphines. The service was very nice and the food was prepared very quickly, although there were some miscomunications with the waitresses due to the lack of english speaking ability. Overall, it serves really good food, and I have been there twice in my first three days in Ho Chi Minh. The price is very good, around 3-5 dollars per meal, and the portion served was relatively big for asian standards, enough to make you full. The best part: they provide entertainment for little children in the form of sudoku and jokes that are written on the paper that cpvers the table when eating. Really recommended for a visit, especially those who favour asian style food and tastes.

Tiny food portions, which is ok, considering the quality of the food, poor service
Mar 2017 • Couples
When we were there, the waitress handed us the big menu card without telling us which dishes were (sold out?) unavailable. So I chose a rice noodle dish, only to be told that it was finished, just like the vegetarian selections. 
After choosing a spring roll dish with lemongrass pork filling, I was told again that it was finished, oh and the one with BBQ pork filling was finished too. So I gave up and ordered the only spring rolls left. They were chewy and I didn't get a peanut sauce, only a fish sauce to make the bland rolls tastier.
My fiance ordered the com tam with bbq pork and egg. The pork was superdry. The marinade was ok, but nothing to come back for.
He's also ordered the banana dessert. Someone's finally come up with an idea on how to repurpose the saucers nobody really needs. Props to the photographer who made it look like it would be served in a bowl!
